XI Sun/Moon/North Star colour-light practice excerpt (16545-16565); Higher Self golden light (12605-12625); Ch. XIII sexual-essence light dots (17945-17965); Ch. XV troubleshooting FAQ 'How will I know when my Orbit is open?' and 'I don't feel anything' (18590-18660) and Kundalini syndrome (19270-19310); colour note in intro (874-890). Organ-colour visualizations (Six Healing Sounds, ~4700-4760, 11920-12050) only skimmed via grep.
mode_evidence: Most light in the book is prescribed visualization ('picture', 'visualize', 'imagine' coloured lights and mists) with no claim it becomes seen. Two places mark seen light: in the Orbit FAQ, 'those who are visually oriented may see a light inside their heads, or points along the orbit may light up' as a sign that energy circulates; and the Higher Self light 'may be sensed with your inner eye as a benevolent golden cloud... fine particles or waves of light floating in space in front of you at eye level'. The sun/candle practice uses the afterimage ('lightly close the eyes and see the light in front of you'), which is stimulus-bound. Chia explicitly makes seeing optional: non-visual people 'may never see any colors with their inner eye' and feeling has 'the same end effect'.
onset_evidence: No method is offered to make light appear for someone who sees nothing; seeing is treated as a matter of temperament ('visually oriented'), not of attainment. To the person who feels or sees nothing the FAQ says: channels open at different rates; after two weeks without success reverse the flow one centre at a time, a week per centre; some students practise for years with no sensation and still benefit. Light in the head is just one possible sign of circulation among heat, tingling, bubbles, shaking. The nearest to induction is the external-light gathering (sun at sunrise/sunset, candle, 60-100 W bulb), whose afterimage is then 'drawn in', but it aims at absorbing 'solar essence' felt as Chi in the mouth, not at persistent seen light.

stages.label: Orbit opening signs
stages.description: Light in the head or points of the orbit lighting up, alongside heat, tingling, effervescence, shocks; taken as proof that Chi circulates, not as a stage to pursue.

what_to_do_with_light: Condense it: draw seen or felt light into a dot or ball, bring it into the mideyebrow/mouth/Tan Tien and store it at the navel; never leave energy dwelling in the head.
obstacles_and_fixes: No sensation or light: continue; after two weeks reverse the flow one centre at a time for a week each; benefit occurs without sensation
Cramp from forcing the light-gathering: exhale and relax into it; don't use force
Bright sun: blink 20-30 times and move the head lightly; use sunrise/sunset, candle or bulb
cautions: Kundalini syndrome: focusing too long on the mideyebrow/Third Eye without opening the front (Functional) channel congests energy in the head, with headaches, ringing ears, seeing flashing lights, psychosis; always bring energy down to the navel
Sun gazing only near horizon, with blinking
interpretation: Light is Chi of specific frequencies (golden Higher Self, violet North Star, red Big Dipper, blue earth, white Po soul); seeing it is a temperament-dependent sign of circulating energy, equivalent to feeling it, and flashing lights in the head can be a pathology of unvented energy.
practice_summary: Chia does not teach seeing light as a goal. For light gathering: at sunrise or sunset (or with a candle or 60-100 W bulb), look at the light, inhale into the mideyebrow and mouth with eyelids half closed and irises 'dimmed', hold 10-15 seconds; exhale, open the eyes lightly and condense the 'light Chi' in the saliva. Add a light smile, contraction of eye, mouth, anal and perineal sphincters, and the tongue on the palate; 6-9 rounds; swallow the charged saliva. With bright sun, blink 20-30 times, close the eyes and draw in the light seen in front of you. In the Microcosmic Orbit, light in the head or at orbit points may appear for visually oriented people as one sign of circulation; whether it appears or not, condense energy into dots and store it at the navel. Do not dwell on the Third Eye before the front channel is open.
